title: One entry of the root Figures list

name.description: Becomes the output filename, and the stable address for `jplot config set`.

enable.description: false skips this figure without removing it.

type.description: Registered high-level figure format. Most types expand to layers; forest retains a native data-driven physical layout. Run jplot cap types.

style.description: Style card tokens, e.g. [a4paper_2x1, rect]. Run `jplot cap styles` for the catalog.

style_card.description: Alias of style for type: macros (posterior_2d / profile_2d).

frame.description: Per-axes frame settings merged over the style card: limits, scales, labels, ticks, legend, colorbar colour ownership.

axlogo.description: Badge settings merged over the style card's. Only the --print CLI option hides the badge.

data.description: type: macro dataset ref (DataSet.name) or inline source block. Expanded away before render.

x.description: type: macro x coordinate (expr / name / lim / scale).

colorbar.description: type: macro colorbar options merged into frame.axc.

share_data.description: type: macro share_data name for the expanded density/profile table.

extra_layers.description: Additional hand-written layers appended after type expansion.

bins.description: type: profile_2d cell count of the reduction (default 100). `bin` is the same slot.

objective.description: type: profile_2d which extreme of z a cell keeps (default max).

seed.description: type: profile_2d seed of the Bridson cores.

grid_points.description: type: profile_2d where the reduction places its points (default rect).

fill_empty.description: type: profile_2d fill a cell that caught no sample.

empty_value.description: type: profile_2d z value of a cell that caught no sample.

grid.description: type: profile_2d resolution of the interpolated grid (default 500).

pcolormesh.description: type: profile_2d style overrides for the pcolormesh layer.

voronoi.description: type: profile_2d style overrides for the voronoi layer.

debug.description: true draws the design-reference overlay showing every axes box and its dimensions. A mapping turns it on and overrides the style card's Debug block for this figure only; `show: false` inside the mapping keeps the overrides but leaves the overlay off. `if`/`then` rather than `oneOf`, so the mapping form keeps precise unknown-key errors instead of degrading to 'not valid under any of the given schemas'.

agent_output.description: Lossy agent digest export (JSON). Written by `jplot <yaml>`; planned by `jplot doctor`. See `jplot man agent-output`.

variables.description: type: correlation_matrix -- which columns go into the matrix. A list names them explicitly (and fixes their order); a mapping takes columns / regex / exclude. Expanded away before render.

corrplot.description: type: correlation_matrix -- R corrplot formals (method, type, diag, order, addrect, addCoef.col, sig.level, col, ...). Omit style for the solved square [corrplot, matrix] card; set style: [corrplot, diamond] for the solved rotated triangle. Diamond takes type: upper|lower (not full), side: left|right, and stripe: alternate|none. Becomes the layer's style. Run `jplot man corrplot` and `jplot cap styles`. Expanded away before render.

correlation.description: type: correlation_matrix -- options for the `correlation` transform itself (missing, min_periods, triangle, include_diagonal). Column selection lives in `variables`. Expanded away before render.

title.description: Forest text block: {text, fontsize?, color?, fontweight?}.

description.description: Forest description block: {text, fontsize?, color?, fontweight?, math?, math_fontfamily?}.

math.description: Opt into measured MathText for forest column headers and values.

role.description: row_name: first bold left column; left: compact left-aligned group; right: compact right-aligned group anchored at the right edge. Width follows actual header and cell text.

show.description: Master switch when the mapping form is used. Defaults to true.

primary_order.description: Axes names in the order the overlay looks for the primary axes.

units.description: Debug 'units' group. Keys are validated at runtime against the packaged defaults, which report unknown keys with a did-you-mean; see jarvisplot/Figure/debug_config.py.
